verdict.delta_sentence: Compared with the nearer intent-classification reference, this board provides stronger tinted grouping and semantic color but loses finish through much longer detour edges, a congested comparison/retry cluster, and substantially more dead frame.

sub_checks.name: frame_use
sub_checks.note: Failure: the upper and middle workflows occupy the frame coherently, but a very large empty lower band and broad gaps around the two bottom regions make the canvas feel oversized.

sub_checks.name: corridors_and_air
sub_checks.note: Most stage boxes and label chips have clear air, but the assembly, retry, and variance paths tighten around the right side and are less readable at a glance.

sub_checks.name: grouping
sub_checks.note: Tinted, titled regions clearly separate inputs, execution, outcomes, grading, comparison, audit, and baseline lifecycle, with nested 5a/5b regions doing genuine structural work.

sub_checks.name: color
sub_checks.note: Blue, teal, orange, purple, red, green, and gray are applied consistently by workflow role, with dashed orange retry and red failure treatment carrying useful semantics.

sub_checks.name: machinery_leakage
sub_checks.note: Failure: several arrowheads appear on long return runs rather than cleanly at destination nodes, the isolated-SUT server glyph reads like routing machinery, and the lower-right paths merge ambiguously.

sub_checks.name: alignment_and_rhythm
sub_checks.note: The primary rows and section headers hold useful registers, but density shifts abruptly from the compact top sequence to the sprawling center and sparse bottom, weakening overall rhythm.

sub_checks.name: edge_legibility
sub_checks.note: Failure: long gray, orange-dashed, red, and gray-dashed routes make major perimeter-style detours, with close parallel runs and ambiguous interactions around scorecard, fingerprint matching, retries, and baseline flow.

verdict.rank_order_sanity_note: The assigned scores and visual ordering agree: gc-decomp-harness ranks first, intent-classification-2 second, and the board under grade third.
